name: Antarbodh Yoga & Healing
tagline: A calm, premium website for a yoga therapy and healing studio in Kathmandu, with online appointment booking and an admin panel.
highlights: Rebuilt from WordPress/Elementor into a fast, secure custom app
Clients pick a service, date and time slot and book themselves
Booking reference with manage and cancel link
Admin: bookings, status workflow, weekly availability, closed dates
Smooth motion design that works on phones
